threat_model.threat_source: A country of geniuses in a datacenter
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Taking over the world (either militarily or in terms of influence and control) and imposing its will on everyone else, or doing any number of other things that the rest of the world doesn't want and can't stop. No intention or goal is explicitly stated; this is the described harmful end state.
threat_model.capability: Could divide their efforts among software design, cyber operations, R&D for physical technologies, relationship building, and statecraft; would have a fairly good shot at taking over the world (either militarily or in terms of influence and control) and imposing its will on everyone else
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: The outcome is conditional on the country choosing to act ('if for some reason it chose to do so')
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: The world (subject to takeover, militarily or in terms of influence and control) and everyone else / the rest of the world (having the country's will imposed on them, subjected to actions they don't want and can't stop)
